Open Data HK Skill - Version 1.0.0

- Initial release providing access to Hong Kong's official open data portal (DATA.GOV.HK) via MCP server.
- Supports dataset listing, detailed info lookup, category (group) search, faceted and format-based filtering.
- Requires user API key; prompts user if missing and saves for future use.
- Clearly defined, structured workflow for API key validation, query routing, parameter extraction, and tool invocation.
- Includes built-in user prompts for missing required parameters.
